description: Music (Clypmint's songs or theirs, where it starts, its level, ducking under speech), exact sound effects from search_sounds each landed on a second, the style's own effects, and the footage's own sound. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: The version_id you read; refused if the video changed since.

muted.description: true mutes the footage's own sound, false plays it again.

ranges.description: Film seconds; the whole video when left out.

on.description: The style's own effects on or off.

asset_id.description: Their song: an audio asset_id from import_media.

at.description: The film second the music comes in.

from.description: The song's second to start at.

music_staging_key.description: Or a song attached in the chat (from import_asset).

on.description: false takes the added music out.

track.description: One of Clypmint's own songs (get_guide sound lists them).

operation_id.description: A retry with the same id runs once.

output_id.description: An output (Short, hook, shape); the main video when left out.

sound_effects.description: Exact sound effects, all in one save.

align.description: Which part of it lands on at: onset (default), peak or end.

gain_db.description: dB under the voice; -20 when left out.

remove.description: true takes this sound out (the one nearest at, or every placement).

name: set_audio

outputSchema.description: Clypmint set_audio result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Change the sound
